admin_settings.title: Administration & Document Numbering Format
admin_settings.subtitle: Configure automated numbering formats for official documents and company standard templates.
admin_settings.policy_card_desc: Configure the sequential numbering cycle for all official Altvira documents. Currently active: Monthly (2026 period). You can switch to Yearly to prepare for 2027 without modifying code.
admin_settings.mode_monthly_desc: Counter resets to 001 at the beginning of each month (YYYY-MM). Pattern: TYPE/ALT/YYYY/MM/ORDER3.
admin_settings.mode_yearly_desc: Counter runs throughout the full year and resets on January 1st. Standard pattern: ALT/TYPE/YYYY/MM/ORDER4 (4 digits).
admin_settings.sequences_card_desc: Manage prefix pattern, padding digits, and reset cycle per document type.
admin_settings.templates_card_desc: Configure default footnotes, payment terms, and standard document placeholders.
admin_settings.confirm_reset_all_desc: This action will clear sequential numbering counter history for all document types. Future new documents will start from the beginning (#001 / Unused). Existing published documents will not be affected. Continue?
admin_settings.confirm_reset_one_desc: This action will clear the numbering counter for {{label}} ({{type}}) back to the beginning (Unused). Existing published documents will not be affected. Continue?
admin_settings.field_pattern_desc: Must include {{urut}}. Other available variables: {{tahun}} and {{bulan}}.
admin_settings.confirm_policy_yearly_title: Switch to Yearly Reset Policy (2027 Standard)
admin_settings.confirm_policy_yearly_desc: All official document types will switch to a yearly sequence reset cycle (1 full year without monthly reset) using new standard format ALT/{TYPE}/{YYYY}/{MM}/{ORDER4} (4 digits). Previously issued documents will not change.
admin_settings.confirm_policy_monthly_desc: All official document types will use monthly sequence reset cycle (resets to 001 every new month). Previously issued documents will not change.
